Question 4
?

The equation x2−6x+34=0 can be written in the form (x+p)2=q. Find p+q, and solve the equation.

a
 p+q=22,x=3±5i
b
 p+q=22,x=5±3i
c
 p+q=−28,x=5±3i
d
 p+q=−28,x=3±3i
e
 p+q=−28,x=3±5i
